ideas.title: Investigating Entitlement Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the allegations of entitlement fraud in Minnesota and the state's response to whistleblower reports.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and track the state's handling of whistleblower reports
questions: What is the extent of entitlement fraud in Minnesota?
How has the state responded to whistleblower reports?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover a larger problem with the state's handling of whistleblower reports and potential retaliation against those who come forward.
